storeId.description: Immutable UUID of the durable engine store, stable across restarts; a run 404 is meaningful only with the same storeId. Returned only to a request sending `X-Claudexor-Store-Identity: 1` (older strict clients keep the legacy shape); absent when the store is unavailable or the daemon predates this field.

sha.description: Git commit SHA of the build; 'unknown' outside a stamped package or git checkout.

entry.description: Resolved entry path of the serving process.

engine.description: Build identity of the serving engine.

servingMode.description: Product admission: 'recovery_only' keeps normal product routes closed while recovery control stays reachable; absent means 'normal'.

stopGraceSec.description: Seconds after a run's deadline by which every process inside its boundary is gone. Physical limits outside it: a suspended host stops the run when it wakes; a task in uninterruptible kernel I/O (D state) dies once that I/O returns; on the marker boundary a process running as another user, one that cleared its environment after leaving the recorded tree, or (once the run ended normally) one whose environment cannot be read outside that tree, is not found; work handed to another service (a container engine, an already running tmux server, systemd-run) is outside the boundary.

boundary.description: cgroup: every run has its own delegated cgroup v2, killed whole (cgroup.kill), so setsid, double fork and a cleaned environment stay inside. marker: processes carrying the run's scope marker in their environment plus the process groups and descendants the daemon recorded for the run; a process that clears its environment after leaving the recorded tree is outside.

items.description: A capability this engine proves on this host: run-deadline/1 is declared only on Linux, after the daemon checked which boundary it can enforce; macOS and Windows do not declare it, and refuse an explicit deadline (run_deadline_unsupported) before accepting anything.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this engine proves on this host. Returned only to a request sending `X-Claudexor-Capabilities: 1`; an empty list means none.
